Criteria.TestCondition: There is no keyboard trap.
Criteria.TesterComment: We could not finish this test, so a person needs to check it. On one load of the page, keyboard focus kept cycling between "Yes Was this page helpful?" (radio), "Submit" (button), "Close" (button), "#popmake-872473 > div". That may be a window that opens by itself, for some visitors or after a delay: when we loaded the page again it did not happen, so we could not check whether you can move out of it. Please load the page a few times and, if it appears, check that Tab, Shift+Tab, Escape or its buttons let you move on. To see it, load the page and press Tab 8 times. The page seems to load more content as you scroll, and the recording could not show all of it; content after the feed was reached only by Shift+Tab from the end.

Criteria.TestCondition: When an interface component receives focus, it does not initiate an unexpected change of context.
DisabilityImpact: With Limited Language, Cognitive, and Learning Abilities
Criteria.TesterComment: We could not finish this test, so a person needs to check it. The page has menus or sections that open to show more controls, and the Tab key did not reach every control inside some of them ("Featured Careers", "NASA Force", "Veterans and Military Spouses" and 2 more), so a person needs to check what they hold.

Criteria.TestCondition: The focus order preserves the meaning and operability of the web page.
DisabilityImpact: With Limited Language, Cognitive, and Learning Abilities
Criteria.TesterComment: Keyboard focus moves through the page in an order that follows how it reads, forward and backward. The focus order departs from the reading order (focus jumps back up the page from "Join Us" (link) to "Home" (link); focus jumps back up the page from "Missions" (link) to "Humans in Space" (link); focus jumps back up the page from "Science" (link) to "Aeronautics" (link); focus jumps back up the page from "NASA en Español (opens in new tab)" (link) to "NASA on Facebook (opens in new tab)" (link)), but it still makes sense: Order follows the document: header, nav, main sections, then footer. Footer columns are reached one after another, top to bottom, then the social link. The jumps up are just column changes.. If you disagree, tell your assistant. After opening "News & Events" (button), the next Tab moves into what it revealed. After opening "Multimedia" (button), the next Tab moves into what it revealed. After opening "Featured Careers" (button), the next Tab moves into what it revealed.
